lines: +// A single large write on an HTTP/2 stream is queued inside the session as
+// one item. If the client cancels the stream (RST_STREAM) while that item is
+// still in flight, the leftover bytes stay in the session queue and stall
+// every other stream sharing it. Splitting the payload lets us notice the
+// stream is gone and stop writing. Streams provided by the user are written
+// as they emit and are left untouched.
